evals.prompt: Create structured Notion documentation for the YouTube video "Python in 100 Seconds" (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x7X9w_GIm1s).
evals.expected_output: A structured Notion page explaining the Python language, its creator, key features, and history, along with relevant screenshots.
expectations: The documentation mentions Python's creator Guido van Rossum.
The documentation includes sections for Video Info, Timeline Notes, Summary, Glossary, and Action Items.
The documentation contains screenshots at key code explanation timestamps.

evals.prompt: Create structured Notion documentation for the local video file "f1_victory.mp4" located in the workspace.
evals.expected_output: A structured Notion page documenting the formula 1 victory video with key timestamps and visual descriptions.
expectations: The documentation includes sections for Video Info, Timeline Notes, and Summary.
The documentation contains visual descriptions of the F1 car or podium celebrations.
